sources.title: Atomic-Germ/Ornith-1.0-35B-A3B-NPU2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FULLY WORKING Ornith-1.0-35B - Q4NX for FastFlowLM (AMD Ryzen AI XDNA2) Ornith-1.0-35B is converted to Q4NX for hardware-accelerated inference with FastFlowLM on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs. What is Q4NX? Q4NX is FastFlowLM's native packed-quantization format - a rearranged Q4_1 layout tuned for the NPU matrix engine's tile sizes and memory access patterns.

sources.title: Ornith 1.0 Model 35B
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.0 Model 35B is an Ornith 1.0 coding-agent model for high-value local coding agents. It keeps the 262K-token context window, OpenAI-compatible self-hosting path, and tool-calling workflow described by DeepReinforce.

sources.title: GitHub - ornith-ai/Ornith-1 · GitHub
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.0 ships as a dense 9B model plus two Mixture-of-Experts models (35B, 397B). All checkpoints expose the same OpenAI-compatible interface and support a 256K (262,144-token) context window; the dense 9B fits on a single 80GB GPU, while the MoE checkpoints are sharded across a multi-GPU node with tensor parallelism.
